sentences.en: When Jonathan Bedine is asked about how he revolutionized dating, he talks about taking a shower.
sentences.zh: 当乔纳森·贝丁被问及他是如何彻底改变约会方式时，他谈到了洗澡。

sentences.en: It was 2012.
He was a software developer in California.
sentences.zh: 他当时是加州的一名软件开发人员。

sentences.en: And he'd forgotten to turn on the fan in the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 他忘了打开浴室的排气扇。

sentences.en: So he gets out of the shower and the mirror's all fogged.
sentences.zh: 所以他洗完澡出来，镜子上全是雾气。

sentences.en: And he swipes to clean it off.
sentences.zh: 他用手擦掉雾气。

sentences.en: After a second, it fogs up again.
sentences.zh: 过了一秒，雾气又上来了。

sentences.en: And he swipes again.
sentences.zh: 他又擦了一次。

sentences.en: And again.
sentences.zh: 又一次。

sentences.en: And again.
sentences.zh: 又一次。

sentences.en: Until he finally sees his face.
sentences.zh: 直到他终于看清了自己的脸。

sentences.en: And this gives him a world-changing idea for his new dating app, Tinder.
sentences.zh: 这给了他一个改变世界的想法，用于他的新约会应用——Tinder。

sentences.en: Which is that users should also be able to swipe.
sentences.zh: 那就是用户也应该能够滑动屏幕。

sentences.en: Tinder could show you a person's face, a little bit of bio.
sentences.zh: Tinder可以向你展示一个人的脸和一点点个人简介。

sentences.en: And within seconds, you could swipe yay or nay, left or right.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟内，你就可以向左或向右滑动，表示喜欢或不喜欢。

sentences.en: And people loved it.
sentences.zh: 人们很喜欢它。

sentences.en: Other apps copied it.
sentences.zh: 其他应用也纷纷效仿。

sentences.en: And in the years that followed, swiping changed how we date.
sentences.zh: 在随后的几年里，滑动改变了我们的约会方式。

sentences.en: But fast forward more than a decade to our current moment.
sentences.zh: 但快进十多年，来到我们现在的时刻。

sentences.en: And daters have turned on Jonathan's brilliant invention.
sentences.zh: 约会者们已经开始反感乔纳森那个天才发明了。

sentences.en: And they are demanding something different.
sentences.zh: 他们正在要求一些不同的东西。

sentences.en: Today, I talk with my colleagues, dating columnist Gina Sherlis,
sentences.zh: 今天，我将与我的同事——约会专栏作家吉娜·谢利斯、

sentences.en: Daily producer Luke Vanderplug, and writer-at-large Amanda Hess about dating in the post-Swipe era.
sentences.zh: 《日报》制片人卢克·范德普拉格和特约撰稿人阿曼达·赫斯一起讨论“后滑动时代”的约会。

sentences.en: It's Sunday, February 22nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月22日，星期日。

sentences.en: Gina Sherlis, welcome to the Sunday Daily.
sentences.zh: 吉娜·谢利斯，欢迎来到《周日日报》。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: Gina, so you are the dating columnist at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 吉娜，你是《纽约时报》的约会专栏作家。

sentences.en: What does that mean?
sentences.zh: 那意味着什么？

sentences.en: So, for the last three years, I have been covering dating and relationships.
sentences.zh: 过去三年里，我一直在报道约会和人际关系。

sentences.en: I have a column.
sentences.zh: 我有一个专栏。

sentences.en: It's called Third Wheel.
sentences.zh: 叫作“第三者”。

sentences.en: Wait, are you the third wheel in the name of this column?
sentences.zh: 等等，这个专栏名字里的“第三者”是指你吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay, so you picked it up.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你选了这个名字。

sentences.en: Okay, great.
sentences.zh: 好的，太棒了。

sentences.en: And I like to tell people that I cover the different ways people are falling in and out of love.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢告诉人们，我报道的是人们坠入爱河和走出爱河的各种方式。

sentences.en: The mischievous and exciting, confusing ways they're navigating romance.
sentences.zh: 他们探索浪漫时那些调皮、令人兴奋又困惑的方式。

sentences.en: You know, we're in a loneliness epidemic.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们正处于孤独流行病中。

sentences.en: COVID changed a lot about how we live, including how we date.
sentences.zh: 新冠疫情改变了我们生活的许多方面，包括我们的约会方式。

sentences.en: So, the idea behind the column and focusing on dating and relationships really emerged out of recognizing that technology is evolving, and so are we.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个专栏背后的想法，以及专注于约会和人际关系，实际上源于意识到科技在进化，我们也在进化。

sentences.en: And I imagine all of that requires you to write a lot about dating apps?
sentences.zh: 我想这一切都需要你写很多关于约会应用的内容吧？

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: You know, it's so interesting that you mentioned the loneliness epidemic, because I feel like when you hear about people being lonely,
sentences.zh: 你知道，你提到孤独流行病非常有趣，因为我觉得当你听到人们感到孤独时，

sentences.en: you hear that oftentimes hand-in-hand as a complaint with the state of online dating.
sentences.zh: 你经常会听到这与在线约会的现状紧密相连，成为一种抱怨。

sentences.en: And the idea of the swipe, like, that we have boiled down the grand alchemy of human emotion and falling in love to, like, a few seconds on somebody's profile and saying yes or no
sentences.zh: 还有“滑动”这个概念，就像我们把人类情感和坠入爱河的宏大炼金术简化成了在某人的个人资料上花几秒钟说“是”或“否”，

sentences.en: about whether this person could be your future partner.
sentences.zh: 来决定这个人是否可能是你未来的伴侣。

sentences.en: Do I, is that?
sentences.zh: 我是说，是这样吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, dating app fatigue is at an all-time high, I'd argue, right now.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为现在对约会应用的疲劳感达到了历史最高点。

sentences.en: Why is that?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: In my reporting, what I've observed is that the price points have gone up.
sentences.zh: 在我的报道中，我观察到价格点上涨了。

sentences.en: A lot of people have become more suspicious of the algorithms, and a lot of people have become reluctant to swiping because of the options on there.
sentences.zh: 很多人对算法变得更加怀疑，而且很多人因为上面的选择太多而对滑动感到厌倦。

sentences.en: They are saying that they are swiping on men who are creeps or women who are crazy, like, using words like that.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们滑到的男人是怪胎，或者女人是疯子，他们会用这样的词。

sentences.en: And I think there then comes a safety issue.
sentences.zh: 我认为这随之产生了一个安全问题。

sentences.en: There have been so many reports of people meeting up with a dating app date who turns out to be less than ideal or who harms them.
sentences.zh: 有太多关于人们与约会应用上认识的人见面，结果发现对方并不理想，甚至伤害了他们的报道。

sentences.en: And so a lot of people don't like feeling like they're being jerked around by the dating apps, kept on there to spend their money versus actually finding love.
sentences.zh: 所以很多人不喜欢那种被约会应用耍得团团转的感觉，被留在上面花钱，而不是真正找到爱情。

sentences.en: Right, because the apps, of course, are businesses, and therefore they are not necessarily incentivized to get you to stop using them, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为这些应用当然是商业公司，因此它们不一定有动力让你停止使用它们，也就是通过让你找到真爱。

sentences.en: by finding you love.
sentences.zh: 不，我是说，我认为当你和这些应用的代表交谈时，他们显然会反驳这一点，他们会说，

sentences.en: No, and I mean, and I think, you know, when I'm talking to representatives of the apps, they will obviously push back on that and they'll say,
sentences.zh: 不，那不是我们的最终目标，但感觉上并非如此。

sentences.en: no, that's not our end goal, but that's not what it feels like.
sentences.zh: 我有点好奇你是如何看到这种挫败感表现出来的，以及人们对此做出了什么反应。

sentences.en: And I sort of wonder how you are seeing that frustration manifest and sort of what people are doing in response to it.
sentences.zh: 他们应对的方式，我是说，人们分成了两个阵营。

sentences.en: The way that they're responding to it, I mean, people are falling into two camps.
sentences.zh: 有一部分人采取了更传统的方法。

sentences.en: You have those who are taking the more analog approach.
sentences.zh: 他们回归线下。

sentences.en: They're going offline.
sentences.zh: 他们想尝试祖父母或父母那一代人坠入爱河的约会方式。

sentences.en: They want to try the dating methods that their grandparents or their parents use to fall in love.
sentences.zh: 面对面见面。

sentences.en: Meeting in person.
sentences.zh: 面对面见面，没错。

sentences.en: Meeting in person, right.
sentences.zh: 出去，你知道，坐在酒吧边上。

sentences.en: Going out and, you know, sitting by the bar.
sentences.zh: 然后还有另一部分人，尽管他们也经历了约会应用疲劳，但他们确实相信科技和人工智能的进化，

sentences.en: And then you have others who, even though they are experiencing dating app fatigue, they do believe that the evolution in technology, artificial intelligence,
sentences.zh: 可以帮助我们，可以改善和优化我们的生活。

sentences.en: can help us, can improve and optimize our lives.
sentences.zh: 如果我们几乎在生活的其他方方面面都在使用人工智能，至少现在感觉是这样，

sentences.en: And if we're using artificial intelligence in almost every other facet of our lives, at least it feels like that right now,
sentences.zh: 那么人们将其视为优化寻找爱情机会的有用工具也就不足为奇了。

sentences.en: then it's no surprise that people are seeing it as a useful tool to help optimize their chances at finding love.
sentences.zh: 不过有一点，我敢打赌很多听众可能会有这种想法：人们不是还在去酒吧吗？

sentences.en: One thing, though, I bet a bunch of people who are listening might be having this thought of, people are still going to bars.
sentences.zh: 他们还在上班。

sentences.en: They're still going to work.
sentences.zh: 他们还在去那些他们父母或祖父母曾经有机会遇到人的地方。

sentences.en: They're still going to places where they would have opportunities that their parents had or that their grandparents have to meet people.
sentences.zh: 所以现在有什么不同吗？

sentences.en: So why is that different, any different now?
sentences.zh: 为什么通过这些方式遇到人的可能性会有什么不同？

sentences.en: Why is the possibility of meeting people in those ways any different?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是因为约会应用的存在。

sentences.en: Well, it's because of the presence of dating apps.
sentences.zh: 这不是唯一的原因，但我认为这个世纪我们社交的方式很大程度上是在网上进行的。

sentences.en: It's not the only reason, but I think the way that we socialize in this century takes place in large part online.
sentences.zh: 约会应用导致了单身人士“拒绝韧性”的丧失。

sentences.en: Dating apps have, you know, have led to, like, a loss of rejection resilience among singles.
sentences.zh: 那是什么意思？

sentences.en: What does that mean?
sentences.zh: 约会应用的存在几乎消除了当面接近某人的动力。

sentences.en: The existence of dating apps almost eliminates the incentive to approach someone in person.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 你会想，噢，真糟糕，我没能在地铁上和那个人说话。

sentences.en: You'd be like, oh, well, too bad I didn't get to talk to that person on the subway.
sentences.zh: 反正我回家滑一下就行了。

sentences.en: I'll just go home and swipe anyway.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 当你没有养成那种习惯时，某天醒来决定“我要出去在酒吧接近一个可爱的女孩”会变得非常困难。

sentences.en: When you don't build a habit of that, it can make it really hard to then wake up one day and decide I'm going to go out and approach a cute girl at the bar.
sentences.zh: 你可能不确定你会得到什么样的回应。

sentences.en: You may not be sure how you're going to be received.
sentences.zh: 你可能担心自己会被当成怪胎。

sentences.en: You may be worried that you might come off as a creep.
sentences.zh: 有了约会应用，你就没有动力去提高你的搭讪技巧、你的游戏规则或你的魅力——不管现在的孩子们怎么称呼它。

sentences.en: With the existence of dating apps, you don't have an incentive to improve on your pickup skills or your game or your riz, whatever the kids are calling it these days.
sentences.zh: 你可以通过回家滑动一天来避免接近陌生人的劳动，并感觉自己已经完成了一整天的约会工作。

sentences.en: You can avoid the labor of approaching a stranger by going home and swiping for a day and feeling like you've done a long, you know, day's work of dating.
sentences.zh: 我还认为，约会应用，甚至仅仅是网络交流、基于文本的交流，以及拥有编辑按钮、能够在发送消息或尝试搭讪之前谷歌搜索某人并进行调查，

sentences.en: I also think that dating apps and even just online communication, text-based communication, and having an edit button, being able to Google someone and do research on them
sentences.zh: 我认为这在某种程度上导致我们失去了捕捉非语言暗示的能力。

sentences.en: before you send them a message or shoot your shot, I think that contributes in some ways to the way that we're losing our ability to pick up on nonverbal cues.
sentences.zh: 无法像你知道的那样，在见面时理解语气，在面对面时捕捉这些信息，我认为这会导致很多误解和回避。

sentences.en: To be able to, like, you know, understand tone when you meet someone, picking up off that in person, I think that it can lead to a lot of misunderstanding and avoidance.
sentences.zh: 吉娜，感觉人们现在真的在认真对待这样一个事实：虽然这些应用最初可能让约会变得更容易，或者看起来更容易找到你的另一半，

sentences.en: Gina, it feels like people are really reckoning right now with the fact that while the apps might have initially made it easier or seemed to have made it easier to date
sentences.zh: 但很多人并没有这种感觉。

sentences.en: and find your person, a lot of people are not feeling that way.
sentences.zh: 事实上，很多人觉得约会应用因为你提到的所有原因，让约会变得困难多了。

sentences.en: In fact, a lot of people are feeling that dating apps, for all the reasons you mentioned, have made dating a lot harder.
sentences.zh: 面对所有这些挑战，我完全理解为什么人们试图寻找创造性的或不同的方式来结识某人。

sentences.en: In the face of all of these challenges, it makes complete sense to me why people are trying to find creative or different ways of meeting someone.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 我是说，看，很多人在约会应用上取得了显著的成功。

sentences.en: I mean, look, so many people have had remarkable success on dating apps.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 但人们寻找替代性的、现实生活中的方式来建立联系也是有道理的。

sentences.en: But it also makes sense that you have people searching for alternative and real-life ways to make connection.
sentences.zh: 吉娜·谢利斯，非常感谢你来到这里。

sentences.en: Gina Sherliss, thank you so much for being with us.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: This was great.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，我们将看看人们试图从滑动中解脱出来的一些方式，要么拥抱科技和人工智能带来的新希望，

sentences.en: or by seeking out opportunities to find their soulmate in person.
